title: Update permissions for G/L Transaction table
summary: Access to the G/L Transaction table is added across Base Application layers: many permission sets (W1, RU, CH, NA, GB), plus the permissions of Gen. Jnl.-Post Reverse, the date compression reports, Adjust Add. Reporting Currency and User Management.
key_points: Adds G/L Transaction table permissions to many W1 permission sets, including D365 role sets and OnPrem journal, posting and register sets
Same additions in country copies of permission sets in RU, CH, NA and GB
Gen. Jnl.-Post Reverse codeunit gets the permission in W1 and several country layers
Date compress reports, Adjust Add. Reporting Currency and User Management also updated
